xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4546: Allow two concurrent quality gates (resources.quality_gate_slots, default 2) with a CPU-pressure fallback to one

plan.title: Allow two concurrent quality gates (resources.quality_gate_slots, default 2) with a CPU-pressure fallback to one
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Quality-gate CPU admission (src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.ts) is one machine-wide slot held as owner.json. On 2026-10-04 on the 24-core host, 5-7 PRs waited 1-2 hours in the queue while load sat near 7 and CPU PSI some avg10 stayed near 0, so the serialized queue bounded throughput. The operator decided to allow two concurrent heavy gates and fall back to one under CPU pressure. Folded in PAN-4610: writeExclusive creates a ticket file before writing its JSON, every poller's listLiveTickets deletes unparseable tickets, and a waiter never checks its own ticket still exists, so a poll landing mid-write strands the waiter forever (PAN-4532's build gate waited 40+ minutes on 2026-10-24).
narratives.Proposal: First (PAN-4610): publish ticket, owner and breaker files atomically (temp file + link(), which keeps open('wx')'s EEXIST exclusivity), skip unparseable tickets younger than a 10 s torn grace instead of deleting them, sweep temp files of dead pids, and have a waiter republish its own missing ticket with its original createdAt. Then: Generalize the single owner lock to N slot locks in the same admission directory: slot 0 keeps owner.json/owner.break (so unrebased checkouts that only know owner.json still coordinate), slot i>=1 uses slot-<i>.json/slot-<i>.break. The FIFO head waiter takes the lowest free slot in [0, N) only when the live owner count across all slot files is below N and today's pressure check plus settle re-check are both unpressured; stale owners are reclaimed per slot through that slot's breaker. N comes from a new resources.quality_gate_slots config key (integer 1-16, default 2), resolved from the global config only by a never-throwing lazy loader with deps.slots as the test override. The runaway patrol switches from one admission-owner pid to all slot-owner pids. Docs describe the key and the pressure fallback. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4546.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No preemption: an admitted gate is never paused, killed, or demoted when pressure rises.
- No change to the pressure thresholds or to sampleQualityGatePressure().
- No per-gate-type slots and no per-project slot counts; admission reads resources.quality_gate_slots from the global config only.
- No dashboard settings UI for resources.quality_gate_slots.
- No change to OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED reentrancy or the OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0 / CI bypass in tests/vitest-cpu-admission.ts.
- No change to the waiter ticket JSON shape or waiter filenames.
- No migration or cleanup of existing owner.json files (owner.json is slot 0 by design).
- No edit to src/lib/config-yaml/schema.ts (god file) and no file-size allowlist raise.
- No edit to the opening overview of the 'Verification Gate (PAN-174)' section of docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md (PAN-4609 owns it); only CPU-admission paragraphs change.
- No maxWaitMs timeout added to validation.ts gate admission.
- No use of rename() to publish owner.json, slot files, or breaker files (it would overwrite a held lock).

autoDecisions.summary: Slot 0 keeps the legacy owner.json/owner.break filenames; extra slots are slot-<i>.json/slot-<i>.break (the issue text said slot-0.json).
autoDecisions.rationale: Unrebased workspaces run tests/vitest-cpu-admission.ts from old checkouts that only know owner.json. Sharing owner.json as slot 0 caps mixed-version concurrency at N; slot-0.json would allow N+1. No acceptance criterion checks filenames.

autoDecisions.summary: Every slot, including slot 0, uses today's exact admission path (pressure check, exclusive write, settle, re-check, give back on pressure). 'Fall back to one' means no new gate starts while the sample is pressured.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's AC requires quality_gate_slots: 1 to behave identically to today, and the existing test at quality-gate-admission.test.ts:101 proves today's slot 0 checks pressure; an unconditional slot 0 would break it.

autoDecisions.summary: Capacity counts live owners across all slot files present (any index), so lowering quality_gate_slots while a higher slot is held still caps concurrency at the new N.
autoDecisions.rationale: Config changes take effect per request; counting only indices < N would let N-lowering exceed the cap until the high slot frees.

autoDecisions.summary: resources.quality_gate_slots accepts integers 1-16; out-of-range or non-integer values are ignored and the default 2 stays.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches merge-cpu.ts's ignore-not-clamp convention; the upper bound stops a typo from effectively disabling admission.

autoDecisions.summary: The slot-count resolver lazy-imports a new global-only loadGlobalConfigNoMigration (never a project .pan.yaml) and never throws, falling back to 2.
autoDecisions.rationale: tests/vitest-cpu-admission.ts swallows acquire errors and runs without admission, so a throwing resolver would silently disable the Vitest queue; the lazy import avoids new import cycles (precedent model-presets/plan.ts:111). The admission directory is machine-wide, so per-workspace project values must not change its limit (critique round 1).

autoDecisions.summary: The runaway patrol reads all slot-owner pids through a new exported readQualityGateAdmissionOwnerPids().
autoDecisions.rationale: runaway-process-patrol.ts:222 reads only owner.json, so a gate in slot 1 would be flagged as a runaway after 10 minutes; the issue body did not mention this reader.

autoDecisions.summary: Flywheel docs note: WI-5 adds a CPU-admission subsection at the end of the Verification Gate section (or rewrites the one PAN-4609 added) and updates the existing admission paragraphs in 'Agent Auto-Resume Gates'; the user-facing page is configuration/memory-governor.mdx.
autoDecisions.rationale: At 56359953274 the only admission paragraphs in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md are lines 903-905 and 919-920; memory-governor.mdx is the only configuration/ or reference/ page listing resources.* keys; PAN-4609 owns the Verification Gate overview.

autoDecisions.summary: Only canonical slot names count: owner.json and slot-<i>.json with i a positive safe integer without leading zeros; aliases are ignored.
autoDecisions.rationale: A loose matcher would map slot-0.json or slot-01.json onto a slot whose reclaim targets a different file, holding capacity forever (critique round 1).

autoDecisions.summary: PAN-4610 is folded in as its own item (admission-ticket-durability) that blocks admission-n-slots, and its files are published with link() instead of the rename() the issue suggested.
autoDecisions.rationale: Flywheel scope addition. rename() silently replaces an existing target, which would break owner.json and breaker exclusivity; link() is atomic and fails with EEXIST, preserving today's contract.

autoDecisions.summary: Unparseable tickets and slot owner files younger than 10 s (file mtime vs Date.now()) are skipped, never deleted; older ones are deleted.
autoDecisions.rationale: New code never writes torn files, but old-version processes still do during rollout; instant deletion is the PAN-4610 failure.

metadata.sizeJustification: Single subsystem (CPU admission) plus its config key, its one other reader (runaway patrol), docs, and the folded-in PAN-4610 ticket fix in the same module; 19 files total.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-0 and decisions D13-D17. (1) Replace writeExclusive (line 149) with publishExclusive(path, value): write the JSON to `.tmp-${process.pid}-${tempSequence++}-${basename(path)}` in the same directory with open('wx', 0o600), then `link(temp, path)` (throws EEXIST when path exists), and unlink the temp file in a finally. Never use rename(). Switch all three call sites (breaker line 198, ticket line 280, owner line 310) to it with their EEXIST handling unchanged. (2) Add QUALITY_GATE_ADMISSION_TORN_GRACE_MS = 10_000 and deps.tornGraceMs. (3) listLiveTickets: delete `.tmp-<pid>-...` entries only when that pid is dead; for an unparseable waiter-*.json, stat it and delete only when Date.now() - mtimeMs > tornGraceMs (skip on ENOENT); compare with Date.now(), not deps.now. (4) In the acquire loop right after listLiveTickets, if no listed ticket has our ticketId, republish the same ticket object (ignore EEXIST), sleep pollMs, continue. (5) Add the four tests in PRD WI-0 step 5 using fake timers, a temp root, and utimesSync to backdate mtimes. (6) Closing PAN-4610: `pan done` creates the PR with a generated body (issue number plus item checklist, src/cli/commands/done.ts buildPrBody) and has no free-text field, so right after `pan done` returns, run `gh pr view --json body -q .body > /tmp/pr-body.md`, append a line `Closes #4610`, and run `gh pr edit --body-file /tmp/pr-body.md` (the gh shim allows this; it only blocks grant labels). This is a post-done step, not a checklist AC. (7) Add `tornGraceMs` to the test deps() helper so torn tests do not depend on the module constant. Verify the no-rename( clause of ac3 with grep at review time; do not write a test that reads module source (lint:source-introspection rejects it).

narrative.Action: Starts after admission-ticket-durability lands (same file; builds on publishExclusive and the torn grace). Follow PRD WI-2 and decisions D1-D4, D7-D9 exactly. (1) Add `slots?: number` to QualityGateAdmissionDeps and export `DEFAULT_QUALITY_GATE_SLOTS = 2`; in this item an omitted slots, or a deps.slots that is not an integer >= 1, uses that constant. (2) Replace ownerPath/breakerPath with slotOwnerPath(root, slot) -> owner.json for 0 else slot-<slot>.json, and slotBreakerPath(root, slot) -> owner.break for 0 else slot-<slot>.break; thread slot through acquireBreaker and clearStaleOwner. (3) Add listSlotOwnerFiles(root) that readdirs owner.json (slot 0) and names matching /^slot-([1-9]\d*)\.json$/ whose index passes Number.isSafeInteger; aliases such as slot-0.json or slot-01.json are never counted, read, reclaimed, written, or reported (PRD D6a). (4) In the acquire loop, after the FIFO head check: reclaim any stale owner per slot (then sleep pollMs and continue, as today); a listed slot file whose readJson returns null (torn or unparseable) AND whose mtime is older than the torn grace (deps.tornGraceMs, from admission-ticket-durability) is cleared right there with clearStaleOwner(root, slot, null, ...) and counts as a reclaim this pass, so a torn file never holds a slot forever; a younger unparseable file counts as occupied; write slot files with publishExclusive; count live owner files as occupied; if occupied >= slots sleep and continue; pick the lowest free index in [0, slots); then today's pressure sample, exclusive write, settle and re-check on that slot path; return { admittedAt, slot, slots, release } where release unlinks only its own slot file when sameOwner matches. (5) Export readQualityGateAdmissionOwnerPids(rootDir?: string): Promise<number[]> that returns the numeric pids from owner.json and every slot-<i>.json, skips malformed files and waiter/breaker files, returns [] when the root is missing, and never throws. (6) Rewrite the module header comment (lines 8-11) to describe N slots. (7) validation.ts:420 logs `[quality-gate] Admitted (slot ${admission.slot + 1}/${admission.slots}): ${identity}`; add `slot: 0, slots: 1` to mock handles in tests/cloister/verification-gate.test.ts and tests/unit/lib/cloister/validation.test.ts only if typecheck or those tests require it. (8) Tests with fake timers and the existing driveUntilResolved helper: set the deps() helper to `slots: 1`; add the seven new tests listed in PRD WI-2 step 8. The helper's staleMs is 1_000, so every live-owner fixture must pin `now` (e.g. now: () => 10_000 with acquiredAt 10_000) or it reads as stale. Keep the waiter ticket JSON fields unchanged. No real setTimeout waits.
